title: Uncurried finite projections of the enriched sequence adjunction
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B_1\leftarrow B_2\leftarrow\cdots$ an inverse sequence of sheaves of commutative rings. Write $\mathscr S(B)$ for strict semilinear systems of module sheaves, with componentwise exactness, identified with modules over $B$ on the sequence site $\mathcal T=\mathcal C\times\mathbf N_{\ge1}$ [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. Use unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], exact evaluations $e_n$ [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension], derived tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and derived internal Hom $H$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with compatible maps $A\to B_n$. Let $p:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal T),B)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),A)$ have inverse image on underlying sheaves the constant sequence, with ring map given by $A\to B_n$. Write $\mathcal R=Lp^*$ and $\mathcal L=R\lim\,U$ with the projection-normalized adjunction [lem-coef-sequence-pushforward-limit-projections]. For $P\in D(A)$ and $N\in D(\mathscr S(B))$ with both $\mathcal R P$ and $N$ normalized (each transition-adjoint map $M_m\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n\to M_n$ is an isomorphism for $m\ge n$), put $V=H_A(P,\mathcal L N)$ and $J=H_B(\mathcal R P,N)$. Define $b:\mathcal R V\to J$ as the transpose of reduced evaluation followed by the counit, and $\delta=\mathcal L(b)u_V:V\to\mathcal L J$ [lem-coef-closed-adjunction-enriched-isomorphism]. Identify $J_n=H_{B_n}(P\otimes_A^LB_n,N_n)$ by [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. The nth projection of $\delta$ is the unique $A$-linear map whose scalar-extension adjunct has closed transpose $$ (V\otimes_A^LB_n)\otimes^L_{B_n}(P\otimes_A^LB_n)\cong(V\otimes_A^LP)\otimes_A^LB_n\xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}\otimes1}(\mathcal L N)\otimes_A^LB_n\xrightarrow{e_{N,n}}N_n.$$ Equivalently it is the internal scalar-extension adjunction applied after $H_A(P,\pi_n)$. After global sections and the specified comparison of [lem-coef-sequence-sections-limit-comparison], this is the global derived scalar-extension mapping-complex adjunction applied after $(\pi_n)_*$. On degree-zero Hom it sends $h:P\to\mathcal L N$ to $e_{N,n}\circ(h\otimes_A^LB_n)$.

proof.text:
Fix $n$ and write $S_n=-\otimes_A^LB_n$ and $U_n=\operatorname{Res}_{A\to B_n}$. The strict representative $(Q\otimes_A B_k)_k$ for one flat-term K-flat $Q\to P$ in the current statement of [lem-coef-sequence-projection-derived-adjunction] identifies $e_n\mathcal R=S_n$. Write $\pi_n^M:\mathcal L M\to U_nM_n$ for the specified natural projection. Its naturality at $b:\mathcal R V\to J$, followed by the unit projection formula of [lem-coef-sequence-pushforward-limit-projections], gives
$$q_n:=\pi_n^J\delta=\pi_n^J\mathcal L(b)u_V=U_n(b_n)\pi_n^{\mathcal R V}u_V=U_n(b_n)\eta^n_V,$$
where $b_n=e_n(b)$ and $\eta^n$ is the scalar-extension unit. These are equalities of actual morphisms in $D(A)$.

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); naturality of the projection-normalized adjunction

proof.text:
Use [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal] on both ringed sites and the inverse of the tensor-pullback isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] for $p$. The definition of $b$ in [lem-coef-closed-adjunction-enriched-isomorphism] is therefore the tensor-Hom transpose of $e_N\mathcal R(\mathrm{ev}_{P,\mathcal L N})\mu_{V,P}$. Since $\mathcal R P$ is normalized, [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] identifies $J_n$ with $H_{B_n}(S_nP,N_n)$ and carries system evaluation and its specified transpose to levelwise evaluation and transpose. Its levelwise tensor/scalar-extension formulas identify $e_n\mu_{V,P}$ with
$$\mu^n_{V,P}:S_nV\otimes^L_{B_n}S_nP\xrightarrow{\sim}S_n(V\otimes_A^LP).$$
Consequently the closed transpose of $b_n$ is exactly
$$e_{N,n}\circ S_n(\mathrm{ev}_{P,\mathcal L N})\circ\mu^n_{V,P}.$$
Here $e_{N,n}$ is the component of the specified system counit; no normalization of $J$ is required.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction] to the map of sheaf rings $A\to B_n$. Step 1 says that the scalar-extension adjunct of $q_n$ is $b_n$: the adjunct of $U_n(b_n)\eta^n_V$ is $b_n$ by the triangle identity. By [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal], closed transposition is a bijection as well. Thus there is exactly one map $V\to U_nJ_n$ whose scalar-extension adjunct has the closed transpose in step 2. Substituting $S_nV=V\otimes_A^LB_n$, $S_nP=P\otimes_A^LB_n$ and $S_n(\mathrm{ev})=\mathrm{ev}\otimes1$ gives the displayed formula in the statement, including its canonical tensor reassociation.

proof.text:
Let $\Theta_n:H_A(P,U_nN_n)\xrightarrow{\sim}U_nH_{B_n}(S_nP,N_n)$ be the inverse of the evaluation-normalized internal scalar isomorphism of [lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction], using symmetry to write the scalar extension on the right. Its normalization says that the closed transpose after restriction is restricted $B_n$-evaluation precomposed with $1\otimes\eta^n_P$. Uncurrying $\Theta_n H_A(P,\pi_n^N)$ therefore gives the restriction of the map in step 2: naturality of evaluation gives
$$\mathrm{ev}_{P,U_nN_n}(H_A(P,\pi_n^N)\otimes1_P)=\pi_n^N\mathrm{ev}_{P,\mathcal L N},$$
and the scalar adjunct of $\pi_n^N$ is $e_{N,n}$ by [lem-coef-sequence-pushforward-limit-projections]. The scalar and tensor-Hom bijections of [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction] and [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal] then give $q_n=\Theta_n H_A(P,\pi_n^N)$ by step 3. This proves the equivalent internal formulation while extending only the first Hom input.

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), 08J9 (lemma-internal-hom); agent uncurrying of the evaluation-normalized scalar-Hom comparison

proof.text:
Write $G=R\Gamma^{\operatorname{Tow}}_{\mathcal C}\circ U$ as in the current statement of [lem-coef-sequence-global-sections-evaluation]: first restrict to constant-$A$ towers, then take total derived sections using one resolution in that tower category. By [lem-coef-sequence-sections-limit-comparison] there is a specified natural isomorphism $c_J:R\Gamma(\mathcal C,Rp_*J)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim G(J)$, with $R\lim:D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Ab}))\to D(\operatorname{Ab})$ the total derived strict-tower limit. Identify $Rp_*J$ with $\mathcal L J$ by [lem-coef-sequence-pushforward-limit-projections]. Let $\kappa_n:R\Gamma(\mathcal C,U_nJ_n)\xrightarrow{\sim}e_nG(J)$ be the inverse of the first finite comparison. The projection clause of the comparison node gives
$$\operatorname{pr}_n c_J R\Gamma(\delta)=\kappa_n R\Gamma(\pi_n^J\delta)=\kappa_n R\Gamma(q_n).$$
The second finite comparison identifies $e_nG(J)$ with $R\Gamma(\mathcal C,J_n)$ computed in $B_n$-modules and regarded as an abelian complex; both comparisons are natural in derived input morphisms. Apply them to the equality $q_n=\Theta_n H_A(P,\pi_n^N)$ of step 4. The result is exactly the global scalar-extension mapping-complex adjunction of [lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction] after $R\Gamma H_A(P,\pi_n^N)=(\pi_n)_*$. This applies to arbitrary $J$, with no normalization or fiberwise K-injectivity assumption.

source.place: Tag 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); projection-retaining comparison and evaluation of strict-system derived sections

proof.text: Finally take $H^0$. The canonical isomorphism of [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections] is, for a K-flat representative $Q$ of the first input and a K-injective complex $X$ representing the second, the map sending the class of a degree-zero cocycle $g\in\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal Hom^0(Q,X))$ to $Q(g)$; it is natural in the second input. Apply it over $A$ to $(P,\mathcal LN)$ and $(P,U_nN_n)$, and over $B_n$ to $(S_nP,N_n)$. Naturality turns $H^0R\Gamma H_A(P,\pi_n^N)$ into $h\mapsto\pi_n^Nh$. Now let $Q$ be a flat-term K-flat representative of $P$, so that $S_nP$ is represented by $Q\otimes_AB_n$ [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction], and let $I$ be a K-injective complex of $B_n$-modules representing $N_n$. Take the termwise isomorphism $\operatorname{Res}\mathcal Hom^\bullet_{B_n}(Q\otimes_AB_n,I)\cong\mathcal Hom^\bullet_A(Q,\operatorname{Res}I)$, $\varphi\mapsto(x\mapsto\varphi(x\otimes1))$, followed by the map induced by a K-injective resolution $\operatorname{Res}I\to I'$ over $A$. Its tensor-Hom transpose is the restricted $B_n$-evaluation precomposed with $1\otimes\eta^n_Q$. By the uniqueness in [lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction] it represents $\Theta_n^{-1}$. Global sections of the restricted sheaf are those of the underlying sheaf, and the second comparison of [lem-coef-sequence-global-sections-evaluation] is the composition comparison for scalar restriction followed by sections. So on $H^0$ the $n$th projection $\kappa_nR\Gamma(q_n)$ of step 5, followed by the second comparison, sends the class of $Q(g)$, for $g:Q\to\operatorname{Res}I$, to the class of $Q(x\otimes a\mapsto a\,g(x))$. By normalization (2) of [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction], this is the scalar-extension adjunct of $Q(g)$. Hence $h$ goes to the adjunct of $\pi_n^Nh$, which is $e_{N,n}\circ S_n(h)=e_{N,n}\circ(h\otimes_A^LB_n)$ by the counit normalization of [lem-coef-sequence-pushforward-limit-projections] and naturality of the adjunction.
